description: Source code for device model helper functions in a device management SDK, including creation of devices, endpoints, resources, and metadata.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new device object with optional metadata from a device descriptor.

methods.name: createDeviceMetadata
methods.description: Creates device metadata and assigns a URI.

methods.name: createEndpoint
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new device endpoint.

methods.name: createDeviceResource
methods.description: Creates a device resource and adds it to the device resources list.

methods.name: createDeviceResourceIfAvailable
methods.description: Creates a device resource if initial resource values are available.

methods.name: createEndpointResource
methods.description: Creates a resource on a specific device endpoint.

methods.name: createEndpointResourceIfAvailable
methods.description: Creates an endpoint resource if initial resource values are available.

methods.name: createDeviceMetadataOnList
methods.description: Internal function to create device metadata and add to a list.

methods.name: createEndpointMetadata
methods.description: Creates metadata for an endpoint and assigns a URI.
